reviews.title: difference between this porduct and daily care treatment
reviews.review_text: I bought the daily care treatment conditioner I have been using it for the last week. I feel it is smoother. However, my hair is thin, no weigth and frizzy, plus the humidity does not help. I have been looking for a hair product and wondered if this workes or not. I also want to know whta is the diffrence between the two conditioners and which one is better for my type of hair. I love Dove and have big expectations this will product will work, so far I love the smell!

reviews.title: strong persistent scent is a deal-breaker
reviews.review_text: This is a nice conditioner in terms of making my hair smoother and less frizzy, but the perfumey scent is both strong and persistent. I understand there's probably a chemical smell that you want to cover up, but this perfume doesn't rinse out when you rinse the conditioner out, and it doesn't fade when the hair is dry. I'm walking around in a perfumey cloud today, after sleeping in one last night. At first I thought I'd at least be able to finish the bottle, but as this smell continues to not fade that's looking less likely. Maybe when it gets warm enough to keep the windows open....
